name: eth_multislot_mfe_gated_capacity_20260813
created: 2026-08-13, written BEFORE any number in this contract's arm was computed
question: eth_multislot_capacity_transfer_20260808.json already tested ETH multi-slot N=3 with EQUAL-BUDGET sizing and no admission policy change (the same h48qual/zig075 quality_threshold gates every slot) -- it failed G2 (VAL PnL +36.82%->+14.15%, -62%) despite exposure being nearly unchanged (time-weighted notional -7.8% only), diagnosed as a MARGINAL-SIGNAL-QUALITY problem, not exposure dilution. This contract does NOT resweep N and does NOT resweep budget allocation (both forbidden by the 08-08 contract's own terms -- 'a sweep over N is explicitly forbidden under this contract; it would require a new one'). It tests a QUALITATIVELY DIFFERENT slot-ADMISSION policy: entries into slots beyond the first (N=3 total, still equal-budget-sized at 1/3 margin each, unchanged from 08-08) are additionally gated by whether that bar's direction-matched predicted MFE (from this sub-project's ONLY signal that has ever cleared its own MI/R^2 pre-registration gate -- docs/experiments/eth_h48qual_mfe_quantile_quality_regression_20260812.md step 1) clears a fixed TRAIN-distribution upper quantile. The base slot (occupied_count==0 at entry) is completely untouched -- same signal, same priority order, same 1/3 sizing as 08-08's own first-filled slot. Exactly ONE variable changes relative to both the incumbent (N=1) and 08-08's failed N=3 arm: incremental-slot eligibility.

what_is_being_tested.mechanism: N=3 concurrent slots, EQUAL BUDGET (each slot sizes at 1/3 of the sidecar margin_fraction, leverage unchanged) -- byte-identical sizing convention to eth_multislot_capacity_transfer_20260808.json. The ONLY change: for any entry attempted while >=1 other slot is already open (occupied_count>=1, i.e. this admission is INCREMENTAL over what a single slot could have taken), the candidate must ALSO clear direction_matched_predicted_mfe(bar) >= mfe_cutoff[direction] before being admitted. Entries into a fully-flat account (occupied_count==0) are never gated -- identical eligibility to 08-08's first-filled slot.
what_is_being_tested.mfe_model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, loss=quantile @ q=0.5, max_depth=2, learning_rate=0.03, l2_regularization=2.0, early_stopping=True (the exact 'strong regularization' recipe that passed this sub-project's MI/R^2 gate and that scripts/research_eth_omega461_live_sltp_mfe_width_20260813.py already reused byte-identically for a different mechanism tonight). One model per direction (long/short), trained on TRAIN=2025-01-01..2025-09-30 ONLY, target tb_long_mfe_h48_conservative / tb_short_mfe_h48_conservative (build_omega1_2_triple_barrier_labels_20260619.py's h48_conservative barrier byproduct -- NOT recomputed, NOT a saved trade ledger). Feature panel: the live bundles' own 102 base_cols (verified byte-identical across h48qual/zig075 bundles, re-verified directly by this contract's own script before use) via train_eval_omega1_2_tabm_3head_20260603._base_input -- the SAME causal, point-in-time features the live parent TabMs consume. NO second feature panel is tried under this contract (research_eth_omega461_live_sltp_mfe_width_20260813.py's final10_latent16 autoencoder alternative is explicitly NOT reused here -- one feature-panel axis, not two, keeps this a single-variable test).
what_is_being_tested.cutoff_rule: mfe_cutoff[direction] = quantile(model[direction].predict(TRAIN full panel), 0.70) -- FIXED at q=0.70 by this contract, matching the exact precedent quantile-relative gating threshold already used for h48qual's own quality-regression head redesign (docs/experiments/eth_h48qual_mfe_quantile_quality_regression_20260812.md: 'threshold=quantile(train prediction distribution, 0.70)'). NO cutoff sweep is performed under this contract, for the same reason N is not swept: a sweep would need a new contract. Computed once per seed (the cutoff moves with the model it was fit alongside), on ALL TRAIN rows (unconditional on any component's active/side signal), never on VAL or OOS.
what_is_being_tested.reused_not_reimplemented: multislot_replay() in scripts/research_eth_multislot_capacity_transfer_20260808.py (lines 59-166), imported UNMODIFIED and used as-is for every N=1 baseline computation in this contract (G0, the VAL baseline, per-seed G1/G2 comparisons) and as the literal starting point (copied then minimally extended) for the new multislot_replay_mfe_gated() function. prepare_component()/PRIORITY/SCALE_MAP/LEVERAGE_CAP/NOTIONAL_CAP/DURATION_THRESHOLD from replay_omega4_6_1_greedy_router_20260706.py, retest_omega4_6_1_extended_oos_20260706.py's COMPONENTS/load_frame_current/DEVICE/COST_MULT, replay_omega4_6_1_greedy_val_20260706.py's load_val_frame/VAL_PRED, and research_eth_omega461_exit_sweep_20260721.py's load_frame/BASE_2025/WIDE24_2025 (for the TRAIN frame only) are all reused unmodified. base102_panel()/train_mfe_models() from research_eth_omega461_live_sltp_mfe_width_20260813.py are reused unmodified for MFE-model training.
what_is_being_tested.sizing_explicitly_unchanged: row_margin/n_slots division, SCALE_MAP leverage multiplier, LEVERAGE_CAP/NOTIONAL_CAP, priority order (h48qual before zig075), direction/quality/entry-timing signals, and exit logic (TP/SL/exit-head) are ALL held byte-identical to both the incumbent N=1 and 08-08's failed N=3 arm. This isolates the causal question to admission eligibility alone -- a budget-allocation change confounded with this question is exactly what the parent contract forbids re-testing.

supporting.eth_2026-08-08_mechanism_still_looks_rea: 08-08's own diagnostic ruled OUT exposure dilution as the failure cause: at N=3, time-weighted notional fell only -7.8% (1.187->1.095) while VAL PnL fell -62% (36.82->14.15) -- the loss traces to the QUALITY of the marginal trades admitted, not to spreading the same budget thinner. This means the capacity MECHANISM (more slots -> more signal captured) may still be real; only the SELECTOR that chose which extra signals to admit (h48qual/zig075's own quality_threshold) was bad.
supporting.the_08-08_selector_is_independently_know: the thing that selected 08-08's incremental trades -- h48qual/zig075's own quality gate -- has been exhaustively shown elsewhere in this session/sub-project to carry no real ranking skill: h48qual's gated short-only selection loses to always_short 0/5 seeds (VAL and OOS), zig075's is statistically indistinguishable from always_short (neither confirmed skilled). 08-08's incremental trades were 38 zig075 / 17 h48qual -- both components' own selectors.
supporting.the_mfe_regression_head_is_this_subproje: docs/experiments/eth_h48qual_mfe_quantile_quality_regression_20260812.md step 1: strong-regularization config, TRAIN R2=+0.16, VAL R2=+0.08, OOS R2=+0.14, spearman VAL +0.28/OOS +0.39 (both p<0.001), confound-checked (not a volatility proxy: spearman(MFE,MAE) is NEGATIVE -0.10..-0.32; spearman(MFE,realized_pnl)=+0.43 all splits). Every other label x model combination tried in this sub-project (TabM/GBDT/autoencoder/TCN/CNN/one-vs-rest x zigzag_action/trend-scanning/MFE-regression) failed this cheap gate outright. If '08-08 failed because the selector had no skill' is the correct diagnosis, swapping in the one selector that DOES clear a pre-registered statistical gate is the most direct available test of that diagnosis.

ADVERSE -- this contract expects a real.modest_effect_size: even the MFE regression's PASSING configuration explains a small fraction of variance (R2 0.08-0.16) -- a real signal by this sub-project's standards, but not a strong one. Clearing an MI/R2 gate is necessary, not sufficient, for the signal to usefully rank MARGINAL trades specifically (a different, harder task than ranking trades in general).
ADVERSE -- this contract expects a real.the_same_signal_already_failed_once_toni: the SAME MFE regression head, used to gate full direction+quality trade decisions (a closer role to this contract's use than TP/SL width), lost to always_short on OOS 1/5 seeds (VAL 3/5) in docs/experiments/eth_h48qual_mfe_quantile_quality_regression_20260812.md step 2 -- MI/R2 gate passage did not translate into a practical head-to-head edge there.

docs/experiments/eth_omega461_live_sltp_wide_calibration_seed_robustness_20260813.md's OOS confirmation section is the single most directly relevant adverse data point available: the 'symmetric_scale9' config (same base102 panel, same MFE regression recipe, same TRAIN=2025-01..09 window this contract also uses) won VAL 5/5 seeds decisively (mean +95.45% vs baseline +36.82%, MDD also 5/5 better) and then reversed COMPLETELY on a single OOS look (0/5 seeds beat baseline PnL, 4/5 seeds went net negative, MDD 0/5, avg hold time blew out from ~700 to ~1500 bars). The seed-robustness check that this contract's own G1/G2 structure mirrors was NOT sufficient there to distinguish a real candidate from VAL-regime overfitting -- this is a direct, same-night precedent for exactly the failure mode this contract is most at risk of, on the identical underlying model family.
ADVERSE -- this contract expects a real.side_asymmetry_may_reappear: 08-08's incremental trades were 44 SHORT / 11 LONG. If the MFE regression head has inherited any of the short-side regime-beta correlation pervasive in this sub-project's other findings (h48qual_standalone_replay_invalid), an MFE-based admission gate could just be re-selecting 'more of the same short-side drift' on the margin rather than adding real discriminative power -- this would look like a G1/G2 pass without being a real fix.
ADVERSE -- this contract expects a real.fixed_cutoff_is_a_single_untuned_guess: q=0.70 is inherited from a different application (quality-head gating), not derived for this admission-eligibility use case. Discipline (no sweep) is intentional, but this means a fail here does not rule out some other cutoff working -- and per this contract's own no-re-tuning rule, that possibility is explicitly NOT chased if this fails.

metric_basis.secondary: duration-gated, for comparability with older ETH numbers

seeds.generation: python random.SystemRandom().sample(range(10_000_000, 999_999_999), 5) -- OS-entropy-backed, not a fixed-increment sequence (per CLAUDE.md Seed-Diversity Ensemble Promotion Gate and this session's own [[tabm_hp_low_signal_pattern]] practice). Pre-registered in this contract BEFORE any seed was trained, to foreclose seed-shopping. Each seed retrains BOTH the long and short MFE regressor (short uses seed+1, matching research_eth_omega461_live_sltp_mfe_width_20260813.train_mfe_models's own existing convention) and recomputes its own TRAIN-distribution cutoffs -- the N=1 baseline does not depend on the MFE model at all and is computed once, shared across all 5 seed comparisons.

G1_premise_compounded_contribution.rule: PER SEED: the COMPOUNDED contribution (np.cumprod of the incremental trades' returns in exit order, minus 1, as a percent -- NOT the mean per-trade return) of the trades this seed's MFE-gated N=3 admits that N=1 does not take must be > 0 on VAL. This directly implements 08-08's own recorded caveat ('G1_caveat: gate on compounded contribution instead of mean; the two disagreed at 08-08's magnitude'). AGGREGATE PASS iff >=4/5 seeds individually satisfy this (matching this session's own established seed-robustness bar from docs/experiments/eth_omega461_live_sltp_wide_calibration_seed_robustness_20260813.md). Mean per-trade return and a permutation percentile (same reassignment methodology as 08-08's permutation_incremental, but computed on the compounded statistic) are reported per seed for context, not as an independent sub-gate.
G1_premise_compounded_contribution.on_fail: CLOSE the line. Report the premise failure. Do NOT proceed to G2/OOS.

G2_VAL_falsification.rule: PER SEED: this seed's MFE-gated N=3 VAL no-gate PnL >= N=1 VAL no-gate PnL AND this seed's MFE-gated N=3 VAL no-gate MDD >= N=1 VAL no-gate MDD - 3.0pp -- identical numeric form to 08-08's own G2. AGGREGATE PASS iff >=4/5 seeds individually satisfy this.
G2_VAL_falsification.on_fail: CLOSE the line. No OOS read.

G3_OOS_single_look.status: PRE-REGISTERED ONLY -- NOT EXECUTED under this session's run. Orchestrator decides separately whether to spend this read, per explicit instruction.
G3_OOS_single_look.rule: ALL of: >=4/5 seeds show OOS no-gate PnL >= this seed's own N=1 OOS no-gate PnL + 3.0pp; >=4/5 seeds show OOS no-gate MDD >= -18.5%; >=4/5 seeds positive in BOTH 2026 quarters (Q1+Q2, the Jan-Jun extended window -- see window_honesty for the window-convention caveat vs sibling scripts' shorter OOS).
G3_OOS_single_look.on_fail: CLOSE the axis. No re-tuning of slot count, sizing, cutoff quantile, or feature panel on OOS.

G4_effect_size.status: PRE-REGISTERED ONLY -- NOT EXECUTED under this session's run, contingent on G3 being run and passing.
G4_effect_size.rule: see selection.effect_size_gate below -- a PnL difference must clear |Welch t| >= 2.0 on per-trade returns AND a label-permutation percentile >= 0.90, pooled or per-seed as G3's own OOS ledgers allow. A paired bootstrap P alone may NOT carry this result (08-08 precedent: t=0.32/p=0.75 null difference scored bootstrap P=0.979 on this exact ETH ledger family).

G5_outcome_ceiling.rationale: identical to 08-08: no window here is clean enough to justify a live position-policy change; only a forward shadow record could.

live_wiring_blockers_recorded_now.one_way_mode: ETH live runs one-way USDT-M futures. Concurrent opposite-side slots NET OUT on the exchange, so N=3 as replayed here is not directly executable. Live adoption would require hedge mode or a same-side-only slot policy -- identical blocker to 08-08, restated so a pass cannot silently skip it.
live_wiring_blockers_recorded_now.occupancy_interaction: if this contract's arm passes where 08-08's failed, the two results are not in tension (08-08 showed the CAPACITY mechanism minus a good selector fails; this contract tests capacity WITH a differently-sourced selector) -- but this reconciliation must be stated explicitly in any promotion writeup, not silently assumed.

fresh_forward.method: multi-slot extension of the imported greedy_replay/multislot_replay execution model; one forward bar loop, entry attempted only into a free slot, fill at open[i+1], exits decided per bar from each slot's own TP/SL and exit head using bar-i state only. The MFE regressor is trained ONLY on TRAIN (strictly before VAL), scored at inference time using only bar-i's own causal feature row -- no saved ledger, no future row, and no parent exit timestamp is read as input anywhere in this pipeline.
